title: Noah's Things and Doodads
description: New Weapons? New Ore? New Food? It's yours my friend!
body: **A bunch of new items that I'd love to see in Minecraft have been added!** Sapphire, a new ore, can be found in caves and is a resource smack dab in the middle between Iron and Diamond. Limestone is also found in caves, with a light and dark variant. Each one can be found and combined into a Limestone Swirl! You can also find new foods scattered across your Minecraft world, including Grapes, Spinach, and Mints. Each food item has at least one new recipe to go with them, allowing for new decoration blocks or new, better foods! The spear, can't be thrown, has also been added! Icicle Stalagmites spawn in snowy biomes, and can be used as decoration, or as a new weapon, the Icicle Dagger!
